title: RCPC representation — product side
description: The pinned, immutable product baseline: elements, their geometry, their material association, and the method binding derived from that material. Additive: nothing here is rewritten once pinned. Also declares the method vocabulary's metaschema and the unresolved-element state. The method instances live in `methods.json`, which validates against `#/$defs/methods_payload`; this file declares no instances.

material_term.title: Material term
material_term.description: A material as named on an element. Project- and language-specific content, resolved against the versioned material-to-method map. This field constrains shape only, never the set of admissible terms; a term the map does not cover yields an unresolved element, not a schema violation.

method_id.title: Construction-method identifier
method_id.description: The construction method bound to an element. Derived from the element's material by the material-to-method map; never supplied directly, never defaulted. See representation.md sections 6.1 and 8.

unresolved_reason.title: Unresolved-element reason code
unresolved_reason.description: Why an element carries no construction method. Exactly one of two reasons; no third state, and neither carries an inferred method. `no_material_association`: the element carries no material at all. `material_not_in_map`: the element carries a material term the map version in force has no entry for. Each reason constrains whether the element carries a `material`, enforced by a conditional on `element`.

geometry.title: Element geometry
geometry.description: The element's placement and extent in the baseline's coordinate system. Shape only; not interpreted beyond serving it.

element.title: One product element
element.description: An element of the pinned baseline. `material` and `method` are both optional: an element with neither is unresolved, an import completes regardless, and a baseline may be pinned with unresolved elements present. Planning is what refuses, not import.

ifc_type.description: The source model's entity type, carried through unchanged.

method.description: Present only where derivation succeeded. Absent on an unresolved element, and never defaulted.

allOf.description: Method derivation is a two-step decision: first whether the element carries a material at all, second — only if it does — whether the map covers that material. A material means either a resolved method or material_not_in_map, never both, never neither. No material means no_material_association and no method.

method_definition.title: One method definition
method_definition.description: What a method requires, as tasks. Completes the chain the product side half-carries: an element binds to a method, a method requires tasks, a task references an action. A method is not a compound; the method identifier is the only token crossing the Graph Service and Planning boundary. See representation.md section 8.

consists_of.title: The top-level tasks this method requires
consists_of.description: What building an element by this method takes, in order. Each entry names a compound of the action vocabulary or an action directly. These are the top-level tasks; what each decomposes into is the compound's own definition. Repetition is meaningful, so `uniqueItems` is absent.

anyOf.description: A compound of the action vocabulary, by identifier.
An action of the action vocabulary, by identifier.

description.description: What the method is, for a human reader. Read by no component.

quantities_payload.title: query-representation, scope = quantities
quantities_payload.description: The `quantities` query scope. Served unvalidated beyond shape.

subject_kind.description: Whether the quantities hang off a product element or a plan task. Both are admitted.

unresolved_payload.title: query-representation, scope = unresolved
unresolved_payload.description: The work list: elements carrying no construction method, each with its reason. What a front end presents for manual material assignment.

material.description: Present only for reason = material_not_in_map: the term the map does not cover.

methods_payload.title: query-representation, scope = methods
methods_payload.description: The `methods` query scope: the method vocabulary as served. The referent of the `method` field an element and a binding carry.

description.description: Optional annotation. Present on `methods.json`; a served payload omits it.
